findings.message: VehicleBase extends VehicleBody3D (Godot 4.6) with proper physics configuration. Framework-agnostic where possible, uses Godot-specific types only in adapter layer.
Bulldozer implements destruction system with Area3D-based destroyer. PROTECTED_TAGS constant prevents destruction of critical objects (homes, NPCs, bridge, boundary).
DestructionTracker tracks destroyed objects with metadata, supports restoration with MAX_RESTORE_COUNT limit. Proper separation from world rendering.
VehicleSpawner manages activation/deactivation based on distance from player (ACTIVATION_RADIUS=100, DEACTIVATION_RADIUS=150). Works with streaming world.
Vehicle input actions properly registered: accelerate, reverse, steer_left, steer_right, brake, exit_vehicle, blade_toggle.
GameplayRuntime integration: _setup_vehicle_system() creates DestructionTracker and VehicleSpawner, _spawn_vehicles() spawns configured vehicles.
Tractor and Bulldozer scenes include EntryPoint, ExitPoint, VehicleCamera, CollisionShape3D, and appropriate lighting.
NOTICES.md updated with Kenney vehicle model attributions (Car Pack, Construction Kit) under CC0 license.
Camera handoff: VehicleBase enters/exits with vehicle_camera.current = true/false. Previous camera state not stored but this is acceptable for simple transition.
